explanation: Off-by-one in xsltSetAttrVTsegment: >= changed to >, when nb_seg == max_seg (10) the realloc is skipped, writing past AVT segments array.
Off-by-one in xsltCompMatchAdd: >= changed to >, when nbStep == maxStep the realloc is skipped, writing past the steps array.
Off-by-one in xsltPatPushState: <= changed to <, when maxstates == nbstates the realloc is skipped, writing past the states array.
Off-by-one in xsltAddStackElem: >= changed to >, when varsNr == varsMax the realloc is skipped, writing past varsTab.
Removed *len < 2 check in xsltGetUTF8Char: allows reading utf[1] past buffer when only 1 byte available for multi-byte sequence.

Off-by-one in xsltGetInheritedNsList: >= changed to >, when the first namespace is encountered (nbns==0, maxns==0), the initial allocation is skipped since 0 > 0 is false, causing a write to the NULL ret pointer.
Size mismatch in xsltNewCompMatch: steps array allocated for 2 elements but maxStep is 10, so xsltCompMatchAdd allows writing up to 10 steps into a 2-slot buffer.
Off-by-one in exclPrefixPush: >= changed to >, when exclPrefixNr == exclPrefixMax (initially 0), the allocation is skipped, writing to unallocated memory (NULL exclPrefixTab pointer).

Stale pointer in xsltCompileAttr: after xsltSetAttrVTsegment may realloc the avt structure, the old avt pointer is not updated. Subsequent accesses to avt->nb_seg and avt->segments use the freed old allocation.
Removed null check on attr in xsltAddAttrElemList, causing null dereference when attr is NULL.
